archive.security_status_en: Global tech markets and Asian exchanges face deep sell-offs following the shock wave caused by Chinese AI model DeepSeek, triggering a flight to safe havens like the Japanese yen. archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, persistent volatility in the technology sector and heightened demand for safe-haven assets are expected as markets continue to digest the implications of alternative AI models like DeepSeek.
